rationale: Reuses existing Step 5 rewrite mechanism with no new state file; BUG-3002's rejected 'widen the contract' precedent was a different category of change (new-content authorship), not marker deletion on an already-rewritten line; Option B's scalar/count diff cannot distinguish a persisting unresolved marker from a new distinct one per AC5, and the existing FEAT-2751 repair-cycle cap already substantially bounds unbounded refiring.
rule: Option A: reconcile clears the ⚠ Superseded marker on the line it rewrites (Step 5 Edit-based rewrite), rather than a fingerprint-snapshot diff under ${context.run_dir}
alternatives_rejected: Option B: marker-fingerprint snapshot diffed pass-over-pass under ${context.run_dir}, mirroring autodev-pre-readiness.txt
